title: Fence every bee skill description at 300 characters
action: Add one model-free #[test] to tests/skill_triggers.rs that reuses in_scope_skills() (skills/bee-* except bee-principle-*) and asserts each folded description is at most 300 characters (chars().count()). Put the 300 in one const. Run it now: it must FAIL, naming the skills that are over budget today (about 17). That red is the expected proof for this cell; sdt-2 and sdt-3 turn it green.
